title: Add a 6 mm hole
summary: Review the target, dimension a circle, and inspect the cut. Knowledge version 1.x is a repository compatibility convention, not an Onshape release.

steps.note_guide: Choose the intended Part Studio and face. Check that the selected part and face are the ones you intend to modify.
steps.note_expert: Confirm the target Part Studio, part and face.

steps.note_guide: Create a sketch on the selected face and place a circle at the intended hole center. Constrain its diameter to 6 mm; diameter is twice the radius.
steps.note_expert: Constrain the sketch circle to diameter 6 mm.

steps.note_guide: Use a remove operation through the intended thickness and inspect its preview. Verify the affected bodies and depth before accepting it in Onshape.
steps.note_expert: Preview the remove operation; verify affected bodies and depth.

steps.note_guide: Inspect the feature list and measure the result. This walkthrough has not changed your model; you perform these actions yourself.
steps.note_expert: Inspect the feature and verify the 6 mm diameter. Guide made no changes.
